_about: missing_keys.py hints (data, not code). loaders: a FromJson call the text scan cannot pair with a json file by itself (file = .cs file name, type = row class, json = file name, dir = "Tools" when the file lives in Tools\ instead of Data\, block = optional top-level block of that json). ignore: a loader the check does not walk, with the reason (printed in the report, never silent). blockLoaders: owner.Load<T>("block") calls that read one top-level block of a json. allow: keys that may stay code-only, with the reason. HCKIT8 v103b: Editor loaders + the 7 loaders HCKIT7 left unpaired.

loaders._why: -steerdata:<path> reads a whole steer.json copy; the default path reads the same file through STSteer.Load<AutoCfg>("auto")
SaveSlot.LootFileName reads loot_ui.json save.file through cfg.lootDataFile (default loot_ui.json)
Preset.Load(tier) builds hdrp_lighting_<tier>.json; ultra is the only tier file in Data

ignore.why: parsed from one tier's flags{} block (FlagsJson), not from the file root; every tier lists lodBiasMul

Overlay(object flags) = FromJsonOverwrite of a tier's flags{} block onto the live RuntimeFlags; by design a key a tier does not list keeps the authored runtime_flags.json value (a code default would be wrong here), so there is nothing to fill
